>This catches invalid codecov configuration during development and CI rather than after merge.

>
>The validation uses the documented Codecov approach: `cat codecov.yml | curl --data-binary @- https://codecov.io/validate`
>

<details>
<summary>📝 Walkthrough</summary>

## Walkthrough

The Makefile was updated to add Codecov configuration validation to the verification workflow. A new phony target `verify-codecov` was created that reads the `codecov.yml` configuration file and validates it by posting it to the Codecov validation endpoint. The response is checked for a "Valid!" confirmation. The `verify-parallel` target was modified to include this new `verify-codecov` target in its dependency list, ensuring Codecov validation runs alongside existing verification steps.

## Sequence Diagram(s)

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant Dev/CI as Dev/CI
    participant Make as Makefile
    participant Codecov as Codecov API

    rect rgba(0,128,255,0.5)
    Dev/CI->>Make: run `make verify-parallel`
    end

    rect rgba(0,255,128,0.5)
    Make->>Make: run dependency `verify-codecov`
    end

    rect rgba(255,128,0,0.5)
    Make->>Codecov: POST codecov.yml to /validate
    Codecov-->>Make: validation response
    Make->>Dev/CI: print response to stdout/stderr and fail if not "Valid!"
    end
```

</details>
